title: A script's newTab sent the moment the app answers: one window, the new workspace in it, and the person's typed command never sent to Chief
why: The window-registry defect of v2.2.2 and v2.2.3 (a second window at launch: the launch window was not registered yet, the launch window stayed on Home and the person's keys went to the Chief composer and were sent as a message) was found through the socket's newTab. new-tab-at-launch now plays the person's Ctrl-` key, which may take another route; this variant keeps the script's route: a socket newTab is the driver's first act, with no focus claim. Since cp/fix-chief-composer-focus a script's newTab shows only when no text input has the person's keyboard; a capture slot's app is never active, so here it shows and the person's keys are the terminal's.
source: dogfood gate v2.2.3 (cp/fix-newtab-at-launch), lead 2026-10-28: keep the scripted route next to the key route

steps.title: one window holds Home and the script's workspace; the command ran in the script's terminal and reached no Chief conversation
